values.type: conceptual diagram; no observed or simulated numerical results
values.mid: Nonexclusive mode co-use within overnight journeys whose recorded main mode is aircraft.
values.mid_processing: Four attributes selected from fourteen by normalized information gain with a fixed two-traveller/two-journey allocation; twenty-three single-attribute groups. Compare group-only and group-plus-public-overall-rate-hint arms.
values.fmg: Exclusive reported airport-access category for originating departing passengers; six purpose-by-flight-type groups.
values.privacy: Only generic group cards go to the model; airport observations, volumes, weights and numerical hints are excluded from requests. Approved six-group derived targets and normalized weights are published separately for offline evaluation; sources and native rows remain private.
values.interpretation: Group-share estimates, not sampled synthetic passengers.
